description: This file contains unit tests for the DataGroupService class within the OrangeHRM system, focusing on authorization data permission handling, including retrieval and collection processing of data group permissions.

classes.name: DataGroupServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the DataGroupService, testing permission retrieval and permission collection logic within the OrangeHRM authorization module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of DataGroupService before each test.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Tests retrieval of data group permissions for a specific role and data group.

methods.name: testGetDataGroups
methods.description: Verifies that getDataGroups returns an empty list when no data groups are present.

methods.name: testGetDataGroup
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a specific DataGroup entity by its identifier.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionWithOnlyOnePermissionForDataGroup
methods.description: Checks if the permission collection correctly aggregates permissions when only a single permission exists for a data group.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionWithTwoPermissionsForDataGroup
methods.description: Validates permission aggregation logic when multiple permissions exist for the same data group.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionWithMultiplePermissionsForDataGroup
methods.description: Ensures proper aggregation of permissions across multiple permission entries for different data groups.
